scope: read-only cost audit of frozen 17-case 34-round uniform fresh impact v3 main arm; excludes all ablations, supplements, template study, independent evaluator costs
subject_elapsed_limitation: Sum of reported artifact elapsed_test_seconds, includes controls + generated and source profiles; not end-to-end latency, may exclude Docker startup and compile/isolation overhead.

usage_integrity.request_id_duplication_note: 12 repeated request_id values are distinct actual dispatches across rounds; 540 unique response IDs, no deduplication of actual provider usage.

limitations: Original token comparison uses final_metrics, which are cumulative repeated conversational prompt token usage, not unique source-text size.
All 17 baseline final_metrics are available; P3 totals exceed visible step metrics by 160307 prompt and 126 completion tokens; retain reported aggregate, do not invent missing calls.
Raw token ratio 1.77% hides 411459868 cached original input tokens. Uncached input + completion comparison is an operational proxy, not a dollar-price comparison across providers.
Provider seconds sum is concurrent service occupation, not wall-clock latency. Request envelope is for all 17 trials scheduled together with 2 case workers and 2 model workers.

Original timestamp span sums include model + commands and cannot be compared directly to provider-only seconds sums. Ten additional-trial public metadata records provide agent_duration_seconds; seven pilot source files here do not.
No complete terminal supervisor receipt survives; final artifact mtime supports completion envelope but not exact coordinator exit.
Excluded all independent semantic evaluation/model auditing, all development exploration and all ablation/supplement costs.
